Wire shapes from live anonymous Google Maps search/qv9Egd, 2026-11-12.
Business metadata retained; review texts, IDs and identities are synthetic.
RPC envelope is constructed by the tests. No cookies, API keys or original author data.

search_with_photos.json, reviews_with_photos.json: recorded 2026-11-13 for Primorsky Oceanarium.
The search answer is kept as Google sent it (business metadata) with account avatars replaced;
the review feed is reduced to the slots the parser reads, with synthetic IDs, texts, authors and
photo URLs, and the recorded photo shapes (sizes, positions).
